summary.text: Morgan Foreman is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House District 33 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously worked as a constituent services director for her predecessor in the seat, Felicia Brabec.

paragraphs.text: Morgan Foreman's career experience includes serving as constituent services director for then-state Rep. Felicia Brabec, who held the District 33 seat before her.
Foreman graduated from the Michigan Educational Policy Fellowship Program and the Michigan Political Leadership Program.

She previously served on the Washtenaw County Brownfield Development Board and the Washtenaw County Democratic Party County Committee, as treasurer of the Washtenaw County Democratic Party Black Caucus, and as an elected precinct delegate in Washtenaw County.

Foreman assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, and in the 2025-2026 session sits on the Health Policy and the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation committees.
